name: rpg-stories-mcp
description: MCP Game Engine Server for RPG Stories — feeds map state, rules, and adventure module to Claude

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n api,ui -c yellow,magenta "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -n mcp,api,ui -c cyan,yellow,magenta "tsc --watch" "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
